analysis_note: Reference clinical-covariate-extended model; patients without post-landmark assessment are treated as no documented delirium.
Restricts to patients with at least one post-landmark delirium-positive or negative assessment proxy.
Adjusts for post-landmark assessment proxy count; sensitivity only because assessment count may occur after outcome onset.
Models whether patients received any post-landmark delirium assessment proxy; estimates association of phenotype with ascertainment.
Inverse-probability weighted model among assessed patients using probability of having any post-landmark assessment.
